overview_description.description:
Parachutes is a meeting management web application for all team sizes in various industries. Parachutes covers the complete meeting process from scheduling and planning to holding the meetings and finally to evaluating meeting efficiency and analyzing data.

In more details, Parachutes provides recommendations for when to schedule a meeting and who to invite. During the meeting, the app makes sure all agenda points are covered, tasks are assigned with deadlines and decisions are made. After the meeting is over, feedback is collected from attendees and detailed reports are generated.

All of this results from utilizing AI. With every meeting held, data is more accurate and relevant to ensure smarter and more productive meetings everyday.
